about: Adrift's palette: every colour the look draws, and the grounds it is read against. Read by the look's Rust (include_str), mirrored by tools/adrift/study.py, and held to the contrast rule by tools/adrift/palette.py (CLAUDE.md > Design rules: inks 4.5:1, large or non-text marks 3:1, every ink on a halo). Hex sRGB; alpha where a colour is laid over the sea. The sea's own tones are Terra's G_ and N_ palettes (Globe.metal), which the ground pass keeps.

glass_rim.is: the float's rim: dark sea glass, the edge that makes it readable at a glance

glass_body.is: the glass itself, a wash over the sea (not an ink; no contrast owed)

glass_light.is: the sun's highlight on the glass, upper left as the sea's sheen is

lamp_core.is: the lamp's heart, a warm white

lamp.is: the lamp's amber, the one warm thing

lamp_glow.is: the lamp's light on the water round the float

lit.is: what you just did stays lit: a wider, softer glow

bead.is: the wake's beads, one a day, amber

bead_edge.is: each bead's dark edge, which lets it read on the pale sea

maybe.is: the maybes: pale amber specks, thousands, read as a cloud not one by one

maybe_core.is: a speck's one dark pixel, so the cloud has grain

silver.is: the nearest real drifter's track, silver

silver_edge.is: the dark line under the silver, which makes it wire

ring.is: the touch's ring, the sea's own (Ocean.metal's crest)

date_ink.is: the date, Libertinus Serif 17 pt, on a halo of the open sea

credit_ink.is: the credits, Libertinus Serif 10 pt, on the same halo

halo.is: the words' halo: the open sea's tone

glass_rim.is: the rim by night: pale glass catching the lamp

bead_edge.is: no edge by night: the bead is its own light

sizes.about: points at reading scale 1; the reading scale (1.0 phone, 1.2 the 13-inch iPad) multiplies them, as Terra's names.

float_radius.is: the float's radius, by zoom between far and near, then held: a marker, never a thing of the world's size

bead.is: a bead's radius, newest to oldest, over this many days of wake

ring.is: the ring's radius as the finger rests, and the beat after which it is a float
